name: Mmock Local HTTP Mock Server
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed local/self-hosted HTTP mock server with JSON/YAML definitions, request inspection, scenarios, verification API and proxy mode; no vendor-enforced usage quota or expiration.
watch_out: Runs on your own machine or infrastructure; hosting, networking and operating costs are separate. This is a local HTTP mocking tool, not a hosted API testing allowance. Verify deployment security and maintenance suitability before exposing the web console publicly.
